purpose._: Locked expanded Home 2026-09-06 (Zillow-shaped after Redfin cut). Full-bleed search. Stacked house carousels. Illustrated doors. No Atlas, map block, town ledger, or market essay on home.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. Search is the Stage action. Photographed house rails and Buy/Sell/Invest doors follow.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all homes opens the Field.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. NOT a seller (they arrive on /sell).
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now?
Can I buy, sell, or invest from here?
Where are the buyer and seller guides, and what do people ask first?

items: RESOLVED: phone-first one-off Field cards and Ledger overrides removed. Barrel SplitCardMedia cards on rails.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-M1): brokers section compact at 390; separate evaluator 77 on its scale, see tasteReview.openRaise for the rest of the page.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12): the hero Buy | Sell toggle's selected state was ambiguous. Selection is now carried by fill AND ink AND weight, and the unselected word is muted on the navy face; the switch is a native radio group so both panels are in the server HTML and the tab works with scripting off.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12): 'Central Oregon right now' was published inside the Homes dropdown only. It is now the #right-now band under the hero search, with its read time, and the menu no longer carries it (lib/site/chrome-live.ts).

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #right-now had no scroll-margin-top, so an anchor scroll parked the claim's ascenders under the sticky chrome at 375. V3Pulse.css now reserves calc(var(--v3-chrome-h) + var(--v3-space-md)); measured after a real /#right-now navigation the section top lands at 80px against a chrome bottom of 66px.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): the hero H1 stayed buyer-framed in Sell mode. V3Stage takes altEyebrow/altHeadline, both pairs ship in the server HTML, and app/_v3/home-hero-search.css switches them with the same tabs that switch the panels. The page still ships exactly one h1, carrying the locked buyer line.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): the #right-now rules were scaled against the largest reading, so 'listings for sale' was full width by construction. Every rule is now that count over the whole read (3,281 + 912 + 465), so the three fills tile one track and none is pinned; the arithmetic is in the trace.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): one house led two rails (3027 Polarstar Avenue on nearby and on price cuts). homeRailRows builds the narrow shelves first and the lead shelf from what is left, so a listing leads exactly one rail on the live 3,000-tile pool.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #doors 'Work with us' had no supporting line. It carries the live broker-roster count ('3 brokers who live and work here'), omitted rather than guessed when the roster read gives nothing.

RESOLVED 2026-09-08 (SITE-12 round 2): #places was twelve identical empty boxes with towns and resorts undifferentiated. Two labelled runs now — TOWNS - HOUSES FOR SALE with the live active_sfr_count per town (the same figure /cities publishes) and RESORTS AND COMMUNITIES with names only, because this page holds no per-resort read — each with its own index door.

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts homepage-v6 --builder claude-opus-5.5 --shots <the 16 files below>. The grok CLI and the Cursor CLI are missing in this sandbox, so the judge chain fell to its claude link (claude CLI, sonnet, subscription): three scorings of these shots in one call, recorded exactly as returned, no re-roll. Builder claude-opus-5.5 is not the judge.

shotSpec.capture: node scripts/take-route-shots.mjs homepage-v6 http://127.0.0.1:3484/ --states 'search-open=.v3-morph-search--live [aria-haspopup=dialog]!click,sell-tab=#home-hero-sell-tab [role=tab]@.home-hero-search!click,rails=#homes-local,dial-open=#homes-local .v3-dial__step--next@#homes-local!click,featured=#featured-community,places=#places,places-resorts=#places-resorts-and-communities'. First viewport, scale 1, palette-quantized, against this branch's own next build + next start.

tasteReview.beats: Redfin.com's homepage — Redfin opens on a bare map-and-search-bar with zero inventory until you type; this page shows a real listing card (photo, $1,624,900, 4bd/3ba/3,413sqft, 2075 Trenton Avenue) inside the first viewport on both desktop and mobile. That's the one clean win. It does not beat a real Bend competitor on originality: the community rails below the fold are the generic 3-card-plus-arrows shape you'd find on any portal.

defects.section: Featured Communities / Browse Places / Resort Communities carousels
defects.finding: Three sections in a row — Featured Communities, Browse Places, Resort Communities — are the identical eyebrow-heading-into-3-card-arrow-carousel with no variation in width, density, or card form. It reads as the stacked-section page even though the unit is a carousel and not a list.

defects.section: Browse places cards — Parkside Place Phase 1, Calaveras, Black Butte Ranch
defects.finding: When a subdivision has no photo the card falls back to a flat solid-navy rectangle with only the name set in Amboqia — an unstyled empty state sitting directly beside photographed cards in the same row, so it reads as broken rather than designed.

On the 375px search-open shot the suggestion list has no contained panel background — rows of address/city/community results bleed downward with faint gray labels ('City', 'Community') that lose contrast against the cream page and visually collide with the listing dial photo underneath instead of sitting inside a bounded results card.

Desktop leads the hero with the live count ('3,208 LISTED'); mobile drops that figure entirely and substitutes the generic label 'CENTRAL OREGON' — the smaller viewport, which needs the inventory signal most since less of the page fits above the fold, is the one where it's missing.

tasteReview.verdict: This is not a cream box — demoMatch true: the tab pill has a real sliding active state, the search field genuinely expands into a results panel on desktop, the carousels show working arrows with full card bodies, and the listing dial is a legitimately better device than a card grid. But originality caps out because three consecutive sections reuse the same 3-card-and-arrows shape, and craft slips on the mobile search overlap and the unstyled flat-navy fallback cards sitting next to real photography. Correct, on-brand, and only sometimes dull — it clears the floor Matt set but doesn't clear his bar of 'breathtaking' or 'interactive on every single page.'
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel grok-4.6 -> claude-sonnet-5; shotsHash (new captures of the listing dial, Matt 2026-09-24, SITE-195). The judge is a different instrument from the prior mark, so this is the first mark on the claude-sonnet-5 ruler for this class and the floor the next pass may not fall under.
